stories.title: FICCI urges comprehensive India‑Africa trade framework
stories.summary: The Federation of Indian Chambers of Commerce and Industry (FICCI) called for a comprehensive trade arrangement between India and African nations to improve economic cooperation, stressing the need for a predictable framework to lower trade barriers and attract investment. The appeal coincides with Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal’s upcoming visit to Egypt, which FICCI views as a strategic gateway for Indian firms in various sectors.
stories.why: Strengthening India‑Africa trade can open new markets and investment opportunities for businesses in both regions.
stories.previousTitle: FICCI urges India‑Africa comprehensive trade framework
stories.previousSummary: FICCI urged India and African nations to negotiate a comprehensive, predictable trade framework aimed at lowering barriers and encouraging investment. Secretary General Anant Swarup said the two regions should explore a broader arrangement, and the call comes as Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal prepares to visit Egypt, a strategic hub for Indian companies.
